 A browser

 an application software

questions.question: Every computer connected to the internet must have an:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IP address**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **IP address**

 
 
• An Internet Protocol address (IP address) is a numerical label assigned to each device connected to a computer network that uses the Internet Protocol for communication.
 
• An IP address serves two main functions:
 
 
• **Host or network interface identification and location addressing**.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Media Access Control **(MAC) Address
 
 
• MAC Address is also known as the **Physical Address of a network device.**
 
• MAC Addresses are unique 48-bits hardware numbers of a computer, which is embedded into a network card (known as Network Interface Card) during the time of manufacturing.
 
• In IEEE 802 standard, Data Link Layer is divided into two sublayers :
 
 
• Logical Link Control(LLC) Sublayer
 
• Media Access Control(MAC) Sublayer
 
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/084231d261afe32361359e45d00442381ce90752b70dde133b91b267df60f6cc.png] 
 
 
 
• **Broadcast addressing**
 
 
• Broadcasting addressing is another addressing method available in IPv4.
 
 
• It allows you to manage data to all destinations on a network with a single transmission operation.
 
 
 
• The IP address 255.255.255.255 is mostly used for network broadcast.
 
 
• Moreover, limited directed-broadcast uses the all-ones host address with the network prefix.

__

• We are attracted towards the earth's centre

• **The gravitational force** of attraction between a satellite and the earth gives rise to centripetal force.
 
 
• Earth satellites are objects which revolve around the earth.
 
 
 
• Their motion is very similar to the motion of planets around the **Sun and hence Kepler’s laws of planetary motion are equally applicable to them.**
 
• In particular, their orbits around the earth are circular or elliptic.
 
• Gravity, or gravitation, is a natural phenomenon by which all things with mass or **energy including planets, stars, galaxies, and even light are attracted to one another.**
 
• On Earth, gravity gives weight to physical objects, and the **Moon's gravity causes the tides of the oceans.**
 
• The artificial satellites orbiting the Earth remain in their orbits and do not fall down due to the attraction of the Earth (gravity) which provides the necessary centripetal acceleration.

• Fc = Centrifugal force on the satellite
 
• Fg = Fc makes Fnet = zero.
 
• Thus net force acting on the satellite is zero.
 
• When the body is inside a satellite, which is orbiting around the earth, the gravitational pull on the body due to earth is balanced by the centrifugal force on the body, due to which the effective weight of the body becomes zero.
 
• The force exerted by the satellite floor on the astronaut is equal to zero__.
 
• __He is not attracted by gravitational force__.

questions.question: The highest point in the blood pressure or upper reading of blood pressure is called
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Systolic pressure__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Blood pressure is the force of the blood pushing against the artery walls. 
 
• The force is made with each heartbeat as blood is pumped from the heart into the blood vessels. This is called systolic blood pressure.
 
• The components of blood pressure include systolic pressure, which results from ventricular contraction, and diastolic pressure, which results from ventricular relaxation.
 
• Pulse pressure is the difference between systolic and diastolic measures, and mean arterial pressure is the “average” pressure of blood in the arterial system, driving blood into the tissues.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

questions.question: What are the two kinds of memory in a computer?

options.text: Short Term Memory and Long Term Memory
Read only Memory (ROM) and Random Access Memory (RAM)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Read-only Memory (ROM) and Random Access Memory (RAM)**__.

__
 
• **Computer memory** is a generic term for all of the different types of data storage technology that a **computer** may use, including **RAM, ROM,** and flash **memory.**
 
• Computer memory is any physical device capable of storing information temporarily.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• The acronym **RAM** stems from the fact that data stored in random access memory can be accessed – as the name suggests – in any random order. Or, put another way, any random bit of data can be accessed just as quickly as any other bit.
 
• **ROM** stands for **read-only memory**, and the name stems from the fact that while data can be read from this type of computer memory, data cannot normally be written to it.
 
• Memory devices utilize integrated circuits and are used by operating systems, hardware, and software.

questions.question: Which typhoon, locally called Uwan, recently made landfall in the Philippines’ Aurora province, leading to the evacuation of over nine lakh people and causing widespread destruction with winds up to 185 km/h?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Typhoon Fung-wong.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Typhoon Fung-wong**, locally known as **Uwan**, has made landfall in the Philippines, prompting the evacuation of over **9 lakh people** and claiming two lives as it battered Luzon with destructive winds and torrential rain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Typhoon Fung-wong struck the **Aurora province in Luzon** with sustained winds of **185 km/h** and gusts reaching **230 km/h**.
 
• It weakened as it moved across **La Union in western Luzon** but continued to bring heavy rainfall, storm surges, and strong winds.
 
• Nearly **9 lakh people were evacuated** as a precaution, and extensive rescue and relief operations are underway.
 
• Over **300 flights were cancelled**, with multiple airports closed due to safety concerns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Typhoon Fung-wong**__

 __
 
• Local Name: **Uwan**
 
• Region Affected: **Luzon, Philippines**
 
• Wind Speed: 185 km/h (gusts up to 230 km/h)
 
• Category: Typhoon-level tropical storm
 
• Impact: Flooding, landslides, power outages, and transportation disruptions
 
 
 
• **Government Response**__
 __
 
• The **Philippine meteorological service (PAGASA)** issued severe weather warnings for northern and central Luzon.
 
• Rescue and evacuation efforts were coordinated by the **National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC)**.
 
• Authorities deployed military and police units for relief distribution and clearing operations.
 
 
 
• **Aftermath**__
 __
 
• Two fatalities have been confirmed, with reports of multiple injuries and missing persons.
 
• Heavy rainfall triggered flash floods and landslides in mountainous areas.
 
• Several airports and schools remain closed, and electricity supply was disrupted in many provinces.
 
 
 
• **Context**__
 __
 
• Typhoon Fung-wong follows **Typhoon Kalmaegi**, which caused over **200 deaths** earlier in the year and led to a state of calamity across the Philippines.
 
• It highlights the Philippines’ ongoing vulnerability to **tropical cyclones** and extreme weather events in the Pacific typhoon belt.
 
 
 
• **Static Facts**__
 
 
• Country: Philippines
 
• Local Name: Uwan
 
• Typhoon Name: Fung-wong
 
• Region of Landfall: Aurora province, Luzon
 
• Wind Speed: 185 km/h (gusts up to 230 km/h)
 
• Agency Monitoring: PAGASA (Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration)
 
• Preceding Typhoon: Kalmaegi

questions.question: The mail Merge function is present in:
questions.solution:
__**MAIL MERGE:**__

__
 
• Mail Merge is used to create and send bulk mail, labels, and envelopes. 
 
• The feature is usually employed in a word processing document, e.g. an MS Word file, which contains fixed text (which is the same in each output document) and variables (which act as placeholders that are replaced by text from the data source).
 
• Mail Merge enables us to send the same letter to different persons in MS Word.
 
• It imports data from another source such as a spreadsheet and then uses that to replace placeholders throughout the message with the relevant information for each individual that is being messaged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e10678290fceaa83e8bcabdb8c0701d6aeec6532d387d356f9388e414b3d8b3b.png] 

**Advantages of mail merge:**

1) It saves time and effort as only one document needs to be checked for errors, so there are also fewer chances of mistakes being done. 

2) The standard letter/template can be saved and reused.

Disadvantages of mail merge:

1) Mailmerge letters can lack a personal touch, because the only individual part, is the data merged from the database.

2) The database that provides the information, must be kept up to date. 

Steps to use the Select Recipient option in the Mail Merge.__

 
 

 Steps

 Open an existing Word document, or create a new one.
